$comment: Select an endpoint contract from $defs. Unknown extensions remain readable; unsupported writes fail.

ActorAttribution.description: Source actor claims, without silently resolving role/name into personal identity.
ActorAttribution.title: ActorAttribution

ApprovedKnowledge.description: Accepted library snapshot eligible for explicit seeding; future imports cannot rewrite it.
ApprovedKnowledge.title: ApprovedKnowledge

ArchiveChunk.description: Disposable derived text, identified by UUID5 over immutable inputs/specification.
ArchiveChunk.title: ArchiveChunk

ArchiveQuery.description: Deep archive query; filters can only narrow current grants and suppression.
ArchiveQuery.title: ArchiveQuery

ArchiveResult.description: A permitted source revision or rebuildable chunk with branch/source labels.
ArchiveResult.title: ArchiveResult

ArchiveSearchResponse.description: Bounded deep archive results with current authorization rechecked by the client.
ArchiveSearchResponse.title: ArchiveSearchResponse

ArchiveWriteReceipt.description: A committed batch result; uncertain writes are never assumed safe to replay.
ArchiveWriteReceipt.title: ArchiveWriteReceipt

Asset.description: Portable asset identity/availability; local paths live in backend locators.
Asset.title: Asset

BooleanValue.description: A strict boolean fact value, distinct from numeric zero/one.
BooleanValue.title: BooleanValue

BranchSelection.description: A derived selection observation; ambiguous paths cannot authorize activation.
BranchSelection.title: BranchSelection

CandidateMemory.description: Library/store-owned proposed interpretation with versioned verdicts and evidence.
CandidateMemory.title: CandidateMemory

ChunkSpan.description: Map a nonempty derived-text interval to exact original evidence.
ChunkSpan.title: ChunkSpan

ContentPart.description: Ordered visible text or a typed absence, unsupported part, or reasoning exclusion.
ContentPart.title: ContentPart

ContextDependencies.description: Small fast-path certificate; policy changes invalidate rather than widen access.
ContextDependencies.title: ContextDependencies

ContextRequest.description: Explicit working-context budgets; indexes and runtime prompt composition remain separate.
ContextRequest.title: ContextRequest

Conversation.description: Normalized conversation identity and source metadata, independent of graph messages.
Conversation.title: Conversation

DisableRequest.description: Remove from recall without implying dependency-wide forgetting or source deletion.
DisableRequest.title: DisableRequest

Document.description: Generic preserved document/observation, using the same exact visible part semantics.
Document.title: Document

Entity.description: Revisioned entity context with explicit origin mapping for independent seeds.
Entity.title: Entity

EntityRef.description: Store-owned entity identity; similarity never merges entities across stores.
EntityRef.title: EntityRef

EntityValue.description: A relation to a specific store-owned entity.
EntityValue.title: EntityValue

EpisodePayload.description: One attributed event; similar text alone never merges episodes.
EpisodePayload.title: EpisodePayload

ErrorDetails.description: Portable identifiers/revisions only; never prompts, source text, or machine paths.
ErrorDetails.title: ErrorDetails

ErrorInfo.description: Serializable failure envelope whose code has no implied retry/authorization policy.
ErrorInfo.title: ErrorInfo

Evidence.description: Immutable evidence identity bound to an exact source revision and content part.
Evidence.title: Evidence

EvidenceAssertion.description: Interpretation of exact evidence; summaries never create independent corroboration.
EvidenceAssertion.title: EvidenceAssertion

EvidenceSpan.description: Nonempty half-open coordinates into exact, unnormalized UTF-8 source text.
EvidenceSpan.title: EvidenceSpan

FactPayload.description: Subject/predicate/value with polarity; validity lives on the interpretation.
FactPayload.title: FactPayload

ForgetRequest.description: Create durable dependency suppression; never expand grants or delete shared sources.
ForgetRequest.title: ForgetRequest

GoalPayload.description: An intent/state, without converting aspiration into an observed fact.
GoalPayload.title: GoalPayload

GraphNode.description: Retain null-message roots and original parent/child observations, including disagreements.
GraphNode.title: GraphNode

ImportCursor.description: Portable resumability against an immutable fingerprint, without physical file paths.
ImportCursor.title: ImportCursor

Memory.description: An immutable revision of a character-owned belief, never a shared mutable library row.
Memory.title: Memory

MemoryAccess.description: Access observation for an exact permitted revision, independent of source time.
MemoryAccess.title: MemoryAccess

MemoryCapabilities.description: Actual implementation support; schema presence never implies a working backend/index.
MemoryCapabilities.title: MemoryCapabilities

MemoryContent.description: Proposed or accepted semantic content; validation is not automatic activation.
MemoryContent.title: MemoryContent

MemoryDraft.description: Mutation/candidate input, without character ownership or a forged recorded clock.
MemoryDraft.title: MemoryDraft

MemoryQuery.description: Bounded belief query scoped by trusted client identity, not a model-supplied character ID.
MemoryQuery.title: MemoryQuery

MemoryReference.description: An exact revision whose current lifecycle and authorization must remain eligible.
MemoryReference.title: MemoryReference

MemoryRelationship.description: Engine-validated edge; shared dates, topics or users never imply an incident.
MemoryRelationship.title: MemoryRelationship

MemoryResult.description: A permitted memory revision with its independent retrieval score/explanation.
MemoryResult.title: MemoryResult

MemorySource.description: A grant-checked original quote or explicit unavailable source, with no machine locator.
MemorySource.title: MemorySource

Message.description: Normalized visible parts and explicit exclusions; graph membership is stored separately.
Message.title: Message

MutationReceipt.description: Confirmed commit/idempotent replay result; ownership remains the bound character.
MutationReceipt.title: MutationReceipt

NormalizedArchiveBatch.title: NormalizedArchiveBatch

NumberValue.description: A finite scalar fact value; units remain explicit.
NumberValue.title: NumberValue

OpaqueArchiveRecord.description:
Read-preserved unsupported source kind; original bytes stay in the raw vault.

This carries identity/coverage and namespaced metadata, never an unfiltered
unknown content body. Normalization must separately exclude hidden reasoning.
OpaqueArchiveRecord.title: OpaqueArchiveRecord

OpaquePayload.description: Read-preserved unfamiliar payload; it never acquires supported write semantics.
OpaquePayload.title: OpaquePayload

OriginMapping.description: Independent seed identity; source evidence can remain shared without message duplication.
OriginMapping.title: OriginMapping

PageRequest.description: Bounded recent/pinned retrieval scoped by the trusted client binding.
PageRequest.title: PageRequest

PinRequest.description: Pin the exact permitted revision; a pin cannot bypass lifecycle or suppression.
PinRequest.title: PinRequest

PinnedMemory.description: A character-owned pin bound to a particular memory revision.
PinnedMemory.title: PinnedMemory

PlanPayload.description: An uncertain proposed procedure, not evidence of completed action.
PlanPayload.title: PlanPayload

PredicateDefinition.description: Independent predicate semantics, including historical/replacement behavior.
PredicateDefinition.title: PredicateDefinition

ProcessingProvenance.description: Interpretation run/specification identity, separate from original source evidence.
ProcessingProvenance.title: ProcessingProvenance

ProcessingSpecRef.description: An independently versioned processing specification, without runtime dependencies.
ProcessingSpecRef.title: ProcessingSpecRef

ProfileOmission.description: Content-free field omission diagnosis; source text never belongs in logs.
ProfileOmission.title: ProfileOmission

ProfileSelection.description: Deterministic allowlisted selection, separate from explicit manual pin ownership.
ProfileSelection.title: ProfileSelection

RankingExplanation.description: Finite ranking inputs and reason codes, without inventing a confidence probability.
RankingExplanation.title: RankingExplanation

ReadManifest.description: Bounded logical snapshot metadata; never a path, credential or access grant.
ReadManifest.title: ReadManifest

RecordAccessRequest.description: Bounded idempotent access statistics; no implicit claim/importance mutation.
RecordAccessRequest.title: RecordAccessRequest

RecordRevision.description: A canonical mutation result reference, never a backend row/vector key.
RecordRevision.title: RecordRevision

RelatedRequest.description: Resolve redirects, inspect explicit edges, or validate a compact context certificate.
RelatedRequest.title: RelatedRequest

RelatedResponse.description: Validation performs no hydration; relationship reads disclose partial coverage.
RelatedResponse.title: RelatedResponse

RememberRequest.description: Propose content to the bound character; engine policy supplies ownership/recorded time.
RememberRequest.title: RememberRequest

RequestOptions.description: Caller deadline metadata; transport cancellation does not resolve uncertain writes.
RequestOptions.title: RequestOptions

RetrievalContext.description: Structured prompt inputs/dependencies; no prebuilt prompt or generated belief.
RetrievalContext.title: RetrievalContext

RetrievalCoverage.description: Explicit search/context coverage; an empty result is not an index/source failure.
RetrievalCoverage.title: RetrievalCoverage

SearchResponse.description: Bounded ranked beliefs, pagination, and truthful derived-index coverage.
SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse

SessionSummary.description: Bounded derived working context; it does not replace source history or corroboration.
SessionSummary.title: SessionSummary

SourceLink.description: Preserve missing/invalid graph links rather than flattening or repairing them.
SourceLink.title: SourceLink

SourceRef.description: Reference an immutable canonical source revision without exposing physical locators.
SourceRef.title: SourceRef

SourceTimestamp.description: Unresolved source clock; recorded/import time never fills a missing value.
SourceTimestamp.title: SourceTimestamp

StringValue.description: An exact string fact value, normalized only through a referenced predicate policy.
StringValue.title: StringValue

SupersedeRequest.description: Explicit transition evidence, preserving the old belief and temporal interpretation.
SupersedeRequest.title: SupersedeRequest

TemporalBounds.description: Optional half-open validity with explicit observation/confirmation metadata.
TemporalBounds.title: TemporalBounds

TemporalMetadata.description: A stored interpretation's recorded clock, independent of historical validity.
TemporalMetadata.title: TemporalMetadata

TemporalQuery.description: Filter world time and recorded interpretation history independently.
TemporalQuery.title: TemporalQuery

UnpinRequest.description: Remove a pin using current expected memory revision and idempotent mutation identity.
UnpinRequest.title: UnpinRequest

UpdateRequest.description: Append a replacement interpretation revision without mutating historical evidence.
UpdateRequest.title: UpdateRequest

ValidationVerdict.description: Persist validation/activation decision inputs; confidence is not a probability.
ValidationVerdict.title: ValidationVerdict
